instruction: A soccer ball reduced to its raw low-poly geometry, a truncated icosahedron of flat black-and-white pentagon and hexagon facets meeting at hard edges. Flat shading with no gloss emphasizes each crisp planar panel and the faceted silhouette.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Soccer Ball in a low-poly flat-shaded style. A soccer ball reduced to its raw low-poly geometry, a truncated icosahedron of flat black-and-white pentagon and hexagon facets meeting at hard edges. Flat shading with no gloss emphasizes each crisp planar panel and the faceted silhouette. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
